title: RM Performance dashboard (API + UI)
objective: RM Performance dashboard per spec FR-58 / PRD 15.2: six KPIs, RM and broker rankings, shared matrix, turnaround-vs-SLA bars, Performance Watchlist with suggested actions, Leadership Insights panel; filter bar uses RM/Team and Broker Type variants.
scope: Route /rm-performance page with FilterBar variant (RM/Team, Broker Type)
Suggested-action classification and insight generation isolated as named rule classes
implementation_details: Features/Dashboards/RmPerformance/GetRmPerformanceQuery: KPIs — ActiveRms, ActiveBrokers, WonPremiumYtd, RmConversionRate, BrokerConversionRate, FollowUpCompliance (MetricDefinitions); TopRms ranking by won premium + conversion%; TopBrokers ranking; BrokerMatrix (same component/classifier as T-034); TurnaroundByRm: horizontal bars per RM (team grouping deferred — no team entity in MVP; RM-level with metric dropdown Avg Turnaround) with dashed SLA target marker from tenant sla_received_to_sent_days; PerformanceWatchlist rows {name (RM or broker), quotes, wonPremium, conversion, avgTurnaround, overdueFollowUps, suggestedAction}; LeadershipInsights: generated one-liners

Domain/Dashboards/SuggestedActionRule.cs (isolated, modifiable): maps performance profile to PRD 15.4 labels (maintain momentum, recognize and retain, deepen engagement, provide more leads, coach and support, escalate and intervene, review relationship) using conversion/volume/turnaround/overdue thresholds relative to tenant medians; Domain/Dashboards/LeadershipInsightRules.cs producing: top performing broker, underperforming RM, turnaround at risk, follow-up compliance, largest premium opportunity — each {icon, headline, narrative}
features/dashboards/RmPerformancePage.tsx with FilterBar variant='rm' (RM/Team select, Broker Type select replacing Broker); WatchlistTable with color-coded action chips; InsightsPanel

T-043 amendment (docs/ui-remediation/plan.md, AC-082): build every screen part of this task on the shared design-system layer from T-043 — src/ui/src/theme/components.css classes (.qiq-card, .qiq-btn, .qiq-chip, .qiq-table-wrap, .qiq-kpi-*, .qiq-menu) and components/common/Icon.tsx — never ad-hoc inline styling or new CSS files. Before marking IMPLEMENTED, do a side-by-side check against docs/prototype/screenshots/QuoteIQ - RM Performance.png at ~1670px: layout regions, card composition, chart types, chip/color semantics must match the prototype (subject to the PRD's documented deviations for this screen, e.g. lead-vs-quote labeling, excluded prototype-only widgets). Record the comparison result in this task's history.

e2e: dashboard-rm.spec.ts: filter bar shows RM/Team and Broker Type; rankings, matrix, watchlist with action chips, and insights render with seeded data; watchlist drill-through

findings.summary: RM-performance permission gate: gated on the dedicated dashboards.view_rm_performance (not view_executive). Unambiguous — the permission already existed and is correctly seeded.
findings.detail: GET /api/v1/dashboards/rm-performance is gated by PermissionCatalog.Dashboards.ViewRmPerformance ('dashboards.view_rm_performance', PermissionCatalog.cs line 185/303). This is a specific per-dashboard permission (not view_executive), matching the executive/pipeline/broker endpoints' pattern. SeedUsers.cs grants it to Sales Head (line 61) and Executive Viewer (line 89) — the PRD 20.5 leadership roles — so both seeded leadership personas reach it and the 403-gate test (RmPerformance_WhenCallerLacksViewRmPerformancePermission_ShouldReturn403) passes. No ambiguity; recorded for completeness.

findings.summary: Suggested-action threshold values are documented assumptions (PRD 15.4 names the seven labels but not the exact thresholds selecting among them).
findings.detail: SuggestedActionRule.Evaluate uses median-relative axis splits (a subject is 'high' at/above the tenant median of conversion/volume/won-premium, inclusive — matching QuadrantClassifier), the tenant SLA turnaround target for 'beyond target', and an overdue-follow-up escalation threshold (SuggestedActionRule.OverdueEscalationThreshold = 3) to select among the seven PRD 15.4 labels. The rule is isolated in one named, unit-tested Domain class (SuggestedActionRuleTests: all 7 labels + boundary/null-conversion cases) so the thresholds are tunable in one place. Flagged for human confirmation of the exact threshold values and the profile->label mapping.

findings.summary: Team-grouping deferral + related prototype deviations: Turnaround is RM-level (no team entity), the watchlist is RM-only, the turnaround metric dropdown is omitted, and Top Brokers ranks by won premium.
findings.detail: (a) TurnaroundByRm renders per-RM bars, not the prototype's team/segment grouping (Corporate & Commercial, Agriculture, ...): the MVP has no team entity, an explicitly task-sanctioned simplification. (b) The Performance Watchlist is RM-only, whereas the prototype mixes RM and broker rows; the SuggestedActionRule already works for both, so extending to broker rows is a drop-in — flagged. (c) The prototype's 'Avg Turnaround (Days)' metric dropdown is omitted because the MVP exposes only one turnaround metric (a single-option selector). (d) Top Brokers ranks by won premium (consistent with Top RMs and this dashboard's won-premium leadership framing) rather than the prototype's quote volume; the DTO carries quoteVolume so a volume-ranked variant is a drop-in. All surfaced for human review, not silently resolved.

findings.summary: Leadership-insight selection rules are documented assumptions (PRD 15.2 names the five insight types but not their exact selection rule).
findings.detail: LeadershipInsightRules selects the top broker by won premium, the underperforming RM by lowest conversion (then most overdue), turnaround-at-risk by the largest over-SLA-target delta (slowest RM), follow-up compliance as the tenant-wide rate, and the largest opportunity by open pipeline premium. Isolated in one named, unit-tested Domain class (LeadershipInsightRulesTests: five-type production + per-type subject selection + sparse-tenant degrade). Flagged for human confirmation of the selection rules.

findings.summary: Follow-up compliance uses an open-commitment proxy; Won Premium YTD is computed over the active filter window.
findings.detail: (a) FollowUpCompliance KPI delegates to MetricDefinitions.FollowUpCompliance(onTime, required) where required = open leads (Open/Quoted) with a committed next-follow-up date and onTime = those not yet overdue. The FollowUp log does not retain the prior committed date needed for the literal PRD 22 'completed by or before' semantics, so this open-commitment proxy is used (proven by FollowUpCompliance_ShouldMatchMetricDefinition). (b) 'Won Premium YTD' is summed over the active shared-filter window rather than a hard calendar YTD, since the date filter already governs the window and no separate YTD anchor exists. Both flagged for human confirmation.

findings.detail: GetRmPerformanceQueryHandler builds ActiveRms, ActiveBrokers, WonPremiumYtd, RmConversionRate, BrokerConversionRate, FollowUpCompliance (6 KPIs); TopRms + TopBrokers; RmBrokerMatrix via the shared QuadrantClassifier; TurnaroundByRm rows carry AvgTurnaroundDays + BeyondTarget with slaTargetDays from settings.SlaReceivedToSentDays; watchlist rows carry SuggestedActionDto{label,tone}; five LeadershipInsight types. FilterBar (src/components/dashboards/FilterBar.tsx) variant='rmPerformance' relabels RM->'RM/Team' (binds teamOrRmId) and Broker->'Broker Type' (binds brokerTypeId); RmPerformanceStore honours both TeamOrRmId/RmUserId (owner filter via lead_assignments) and BrokerTypeId. Route /rm-performance un-stubbed (router.tsx line 166). Every element of AC-057 is satisfied.

findings.summary: AC-080 / V-080 GRADED: MetricDefinitions delegation rigorously verified with zero bypass. Every ratio/average/percentage delegates to Domain.Metrics; quadrants to QuadrantClassifier; rules to the two isolated Domain rule classes.
findings.detail: Grepped GetRmPerformanceQueryHandler for inline ratio/average/percentage arithmetic: the only '/', '*', '100' hits are in comments (lines 228-229, 321). RmConversionRate + BrokerConversionRate + per-RM/per-broker conversion all call MetricDefinitions.ConversionRate; turnaround calls MetricDefinitions.AverageTurnaroundDays; the compliance KPI calls MetricDefinitions.FollowUpCompliance; matrix splits/medians call QuadrantClassifier.Median/Classify; watchlist->SuggestedActionRule.Evaluate; insights->LeadershipInsightRules.Generate. FollowUpCompliance_ShouldMatchMetricDefinition pins the KPI to MetricDefinitions.FollowUpCompliance(2,3) against a hand-computed fixture (verified passing). SuggestedActionRule + LeadershipInsightRules are pure, DB-free, deterministic static Domain classes (no I/O, tenant, or clock dependency) with real unit coverage (SuggestedActionRuleTests: all 7 PRD 15.4 labels + inclusive-median boundary + at-target turnaround + null-conversion; LeadershipInsightRulesTests: 5 types + per-type subject selection + sparse-tenant degrade). NON-BLOCKING OBSERVATION: openPipelinePremium is computed as an inline .Sum(CurrentQuotedPremium ?? EstimatedPremium ?? 0) rather than via MetricDefinitions.OpenPipelinePremium; this is a summation aggregate (not a ratio/average/percentage), so it is outside AC-080's formula-isolation scope, but delegating it would be marginally cleaner. Also NON-BLOCKING: no automated architecture test asserting 'no dashboard handler contains inline conversion arithmetic' exists (V-080's approach mentions one); satisfied here by manual grep + the single-home unit tests.

findings.summary: Ruling on F-035-6 / T-034 F-034-4: palette consolidation CONFIRMED complete. quadrantPalette.ts is now the single source; the duplicate palettes.ts quadrant trio and the dead ScatterChartWidget are gone.

findings.summary: Ruling on F-035-1: permission gate + tenant isolation + drill breadth verified correct with no seeded-role regression.
findings.detail: GET /api/v1/dashboards/rm-performance is gated by PermissionCatalog.Dashboards.ViewRmPerformance (DashboardEndpoints.cs line 36; catalog line 185/303). SeedUsers.cs grants it to Sales Head (line 61) and Executive Viewer (line 89) — both PRD leadership personas reach it; RM/Underwriter/Sales-Ops correctly lack it. RmPerformance_WhenCallerLacksViewRmPerformancePermission_ShouldReturn403 proves the deny path. RmPerformanceStore applies an explicit TenantId == _tenantContext.TenantId predicate on every read (brokers/leads/quotes/versions/assignments); the drill path (RmDrillRowQuery -> ListDrillRowsAsync) enforces the Q-6/A-17 breadth rule via callerHasViewAll (restricting to the caller's assigned leads when false), matching LeadStore. No cross-tenant leakage path. No high/critical/major security findings.

findings.summary: Ruling on F-035-2/3/4/5: all documented deviations/assumptions are defensible MVP simplifications; none drops a REQUIRED AC-057/FR-58 capability. Accepted non-blocking; two items recommended for human confirmation.
findings.detail: F-035-3(a) turnaround RM-level not team: MVP has no team entity; AC-057 requires 'turnaround bars with dashed SLA target' (present), not team grouping; the RM/Team filter is still exposed — ACCEPT. (b) watchlist RM-only vs prototype mixed RM+broker: AC-057 requires 'watchlist with suggested-action chips' (present); SuggestedActionRule already works for brokers so extension is a drop-in — ACCEPT. (c) turnaround metric dropdown omitted: single MVP turnaround metric; not an AC-057 requirement — ACCEPT. (d) Top Brokers ranked by won premium vs prototype quote volume: AC-057 requires 'RM/broker rankings' without prescribing the metric; DTO carries quoteVolume for a future variant; consistent with the won-premium leadership framing (the matrix x-axis still uses quote volume) — ACCEPT. F-035-2 (suggested-action thresholds) and F-035-4 (insight selection): documented, isolated in one unit-tested Domain class each, tunable in one place — ACCEPT, surface thresholds/selection rules for human confirmation. F-035-5(a) follow-up-compliance open-commitment proxy: reasonable given the FollowUp log lacks the prior committed date, delegates to MetricDefinitions — ACCEPT, flag for human confirmation of the literal PRD 22 semantics. F-035-5(b) 'Won Premium YTD' computed over the active filter window (not calendar YTD): consistent with the shared-filter architecture across all dashboards and with the prototype's label, but the 'YTD' wording is technically misleading when a sub-year date filter is active — ACCEPT non-blocking, RECOMMEND a human decide whether to relabel (e.g. 'Won Premium') or anchor to a calendar-YTD window. None of these block PASS.
